title: Multiplayer typing
heroDescription: A room for your friends and a place for you. Grab your host’s code and meet everyone around the keyboard.

homeContent.eyebrow: A little room for your crew
homeContent.stepsDescription: Three simple steps to find your friends.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Ask your host for the room’s 6-character code and enter it on the join page.

character.title: Pick your character
character.description: Choose your look and, as a guest, a nickname. You can join without an account.

crew.title: Meet the crew
crew.description: Step into the lobby and see who’s there. The list updates as friends come and go.

homeContent.hostDescription: Create your own room, choose its name and capacity, then share the code with your friends.
homeContent.hostAccountRequired: An account is required to create a room.

createDescription: Your room, your crew. Bring everyone together around the keyboard.
joinDescription: Enter the code shared by your host.
guestDescription: Enter your room code, then pick a nickname and a character.
accountRequired: Sign in to an account to create your room.
footerTagline: A code, some friends, and you’re in!
loginDescription: Sign in and get your room ready.
signupDescription: An account to create your own rooms.
loginPrompt: Already have an account? Sign in.
shareCode: Share this code to invite your friends.

lobbies.description: Find a public room and meet the crew. Choose your role and character before joining.
lobbies.emptyDescription: Create a public room, or join a room with its code. Creating a room requires an account.
lobbies.full: Participant slots are full. You can still choose spectator when joining.
lobbies.notJoinable: Joining will be available when the room is waiting or showing results.
lobbies.visibilityHint: Public rooms appear in See Lobbies. On-code rooms are only accessible with their code.

quickPlay.title: Quick play
quickPlay.description: Find the public room closest to full, with a participant slot available.
quickPlay.emptyAccount: No public room has a participant slot available. You can create one.
quickPlay.emptyGuest: No public room has a participant slot available. Try again later, or join with a code.

guestLimit: Guests can join a room, but cannot create one.
guestWarning: Sign out before creating or signing into an account. Your guest identity will not be merged.
noRecovery: Email is required at signup. Password recovery is not available.
roomIntro: Create a room or join with its code.
roomConflict: You are already in a room. Leave it before joining another.

errors.VALIDATION: Check the values and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Sign in again or check your username and password.
errors.CONFLICT: The request conflicts with the current state. You may already be in a room.
errors.ROOM_FULL: This room has no participant slots left.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: My profile
profile.editDescription: The name your crew sees, and a photo that feels like you.
profile.nameHint: 3–20 characters. Your sign-in username stays the same.
profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 2 MB. Cropped to a square.
profile.photoError: Choose a photo no larger than 2 MB.
profile.validationError: Use a name of 3–20 characters and a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP photo up to 2 MB.
profile.signInNotice: Sign in to see and edit your profile.
profile.guestNotice: Profiles are for accounts. As a guest, you can join a room without a personal photo or saved race history.
profile.statsUnavailable: Stats will be available when races are ready.
profile.progressUnavailable: Your WPM over time will appear here once races and results are available.
profile.historyUnavailable: Race history will be available when races are ready.
profile.chartDescription: WPM for the last 30 races, oldest to newest.
profile.legacyRanks: Older results without rankings are excluded from the win total.
profile.resultsUnavailable: These results are unavailable for this account or this older race.

play.kickWarning: {name} will be removed from this room and cannot rejoin with this identity.
play.entryEyebrow: A spot at the starting line
play.entryDescription: One room. Your people. Find your way in.
play.roomCodeHint: Enter your host’s 6-character code. No 0, O, 1, I or L.
play.editorDescription: Choose your character, then meet the crew.

authErrors.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Sign in or use a different email address.
authErrors.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose a different username.

items.title: Mystery boxes
items.rules: Each racer collects their own boxes at 25, 50 and 75%. Bonuses activate immediately; their strength depends on the racer’s position.
items.checkpoints: Each lane has independent boxes at 25, 50 and 75% of that racer’s progress.
items.shortcutDescription: Removes up to {count} unstarted words from your text.
items.detourDescription: Adds {count} words to the active leader’s text.
items.fogDescription: Hides the active leader’s upcoming words for {seconds} seconds.
items.shieldDescription: Blocks the next incoming penalty, then disappears.
items.nudgeDescription: Removes one unstarted word from the end of your text.
items.empty: No items in reserve. Keep typing to stay in the race!
items.unavailable: This item cannot take effect right now. It stays in reserve; keep racing.
items.catchupDescription: Shortens your remaining words to bring you toward the middle of the pack. Never finishes the race or changes your WPM.
items.shockwaveDescription: Immediately adds 2 to 4 words to every racer still typing ahead of you.

race.minimum: At least two participants, including one human. Spectators do not count.
race.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start the race.
race.saved: Results are saved. Create an account from your guest session to keep your statistics and history.
race.waitingReplay: Waiting for the host to prepare the next race.
race.physicalKeyboard: Use a physical keyboard on a screen at least 640 pixels wide to type in this race. You can follow the track here.
race.requiredHint: Click the text and type directly. Correct each error with Backspace. Pasting is disabled.
race.freeHint: Click the text and type directly. Finishers are ranked by accuracy, then by finish time when accuracy is equal.
race.spectating: You are watching this race as a spectator.
race.retrying: Connection interrupted. Your pending edits will be retried.
race.reconnecting: Reconnecting. Typing will resume when your room connection is restored.
race.abandonDescription: Your current progress will be ranked as abandoned. You can keep watching the race.
race.leaveDescription: Leaving now abandons your race. If no account can take over as host, the room will close.
race.closeDescription: Everyone will leave the room. Saved account results are kept.
race.coherentFilters: Character filters are disabled for coherent excerpts. Options preserve or remove characters from the source text.
race.filtersHint: Each included character must appear at least once. Excluded characters are forbidden. A combination with no matching word is refused at start.
race.coherentDifficulty: Complexity: average word length, ranked into three thirds among compatible excerpts.
race.randomDifficulty: Easy: 1–4 letters; medium: 5–7; hard: 8 or more.
race.botsHint: Bots occupy a participant seat. Levels 1–5: about 15, 30, 45, 65 and 85 WPM before errors and hesitation.
race.saveHint: Save your settings before starting the race.
race.settingsLocked: Settings are locked during the race.

heatmap.title: Key heatmap
heatmap.description: Characters typed during completed races, with uppercase and lowercase combined. Corrected mistakes still count.
heatmap.coverage: {count, plural, =0 {No races with per-key data.} one {# race with per-key data.} other {# races with per-key data.}} Older races without this data are excluded.
heatmap.empty: Play a new race to start filling your heatmap.
heatmap.errorLegend: Redder keys have a higher error rate (0 to 100%).
heatmap.frequencyLegend: Bluer keys are used more often (relative to the most used key).
heatmap.inspect: Hover, tap or focus a key to see its statistics.

invites.title: Invite someone
invites.description: Create a link valid for one hour and one successful entry. Opening the link does not use it up.
invites.copyFailed: Copying or sharing is unavailable. Select and copy the link above.
invites.unavailable: This invitation link has already been used, has expired or does not exist. Ask the host for a new link.
